svg.title: Upstream merged. Four owners preserved.
svg.desc: Upstream main eea67d1 and the four-player branch converge at merge commit 471f7f7, resolving seven conflicts. Independent ownership, read-only spectators and all-player first-to agreement are preserved. Protocol 10 and save-state format 12 identify the combined implementation. Local synchronization is checked; four-machine internet play and physical controllers remain pending.
